package_info.why_malicious: There is no evidence or reporting of malicious code in the ldapjs package itself. The package was decommissioned due to maintainer harassment, not due to any discovered malware or compromise. The report highlights the risk of social engineering and maintainer harassment as a precursor to potential supply chain attacks, but no actual compromise or malicious code was found in any released version.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: There is no indication of malware or compromise in the ldapjs package. No detection is necessary for this package at this time. However, the report highlights the risk of social engineering and harassment as a precursor to potential supply chain attacks. As a precaution, monitoring for sudden maintainer changes, suspicious new maintainers, or unexpected package updates is recommended to detect possible future compromise attempts.
